mapper.insert: insert into employee (username, password, role, name, sex, no, age, description, department_id, avatar) values(#{username}, #{password}, #{role}, #{name}, #{sex}, #{no}, #{age}, #{description}, #{departmentId}, #{avatar})
mapper.select:
select id, username, role, name, sex, age, no, description, department_id, avatar from employee
username like concat('%', #{username}, '%') password like concat('%', #{password}, '%') name like concat('%', #{name}, '%') sex like concat('%', #{sex}, '%') age like concat('%', #{age}, '%') no like concat('%', #{no}, '%') description like concat('%', #{description}, '%') department_id like concat('%', #{departmentId}, '%')
order by department_id asc
mapper.delete: delete from employee where id in #{id}
